column1: # Icon registry - one row per segment
# nerd    = Nerd Font glyph (Unicode codepoint as \uXXXX)
# emoji   = Emoji fallback  (works on all modern terminals without any font)
# unicode = Plain Unicode symbol (broader support than emoji, no font needed)
# ascii   = Pure ASCII text (guaranteed to work everywhere)
# To add a new segment: add one row here, no other file needs changing for icons.
